children: Perspective Therapeutics updated its corporate presentation highlighting progress across three clinical-stage 212Pb radiopharmaceutical programs and a combined $45B+ solid tumor market opportunity.
Updated presentation filed as Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K describing corporate strategy and pipeline details.
Three independent clinical-stage programs (VMT-α-NET, VMT01, PSV359) target distinct solid tumor opportunities with data in 2026.
Company positions VMT-α-NET, VMT01, PSV359 and PSV594 against a combined $45B+ addressable solid tumor market.
VMT-α-NET and VMT01 reported clinical activity in ASCO/2026 data; VMT-α-NET shows durable disease control and a favorable safety profile across doses.
Emphasis on 212Pb-based theranostic platform, regional isotope production, manufacturing strategy, and broad IP protecting the radiopharmaceutical value chain.
